name: Short intervals supplying a square-product extension
description: construct() -> 1..100 distinct integers strictly larger than 210 and at most 10210. Their product multiplied by 210 must be a perfect square. Minimize max(selected integers)-210. An arbitrary-precision integer square root verifies the exact condition. The task fixes n=210, a nonsquare, and bounds the certificate and following window. A certificate gives an upper bound on t_210; exact optimality and the distribution over n are not established.

sources.locator: Hung M. Bui, Kyle Pratt and Alexandru Zaharescu, A problem of Erdős–Graham–Granville–Selfridge on integral points on hyperelliptic curves (2022 preprint; 2024 publication). Abstract defines t_n as the least following-interval length whose selected members multiply with n to a square.
